column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a branch that only adds a pending section reads clean
a current section the marker does not name is refused
a fold that main moved past merges and reads clean, and the section that landed after it waits
a pending section that carries an id is refused
a second --section on the same branch rewrites that file and makes no other
a section written in beside the current one, the marker left alone, is refused too
and a hand rotation that archives a stale copy of the section says what it drops
and drops the id its heading carried, since only the fold gives ids
and exits 0 on a clean one
and leaves a file named for a branch whose name only ends like this one's
and says an archived section is never rewritten
and says it dropped it
and says so
and so is removing one
and the handoff sections waiting in docs/handoff/pending/, newest first, beside it
and the next fold gives it the id after theirs
and the refusal says how to add a section instead
another section put in place under the current id is refused, since the one it replaced is lost
but only the newest five, and the rest counted
editing the current section in place, its heading kept, reads clean
felix handoff --rotate folds and reads its work back clean
felix handoff --section writes the section to docs/handoff/pending/<UTC time>-<branch>.md
folding a section ahead of one that landed before it is refused
handoff-check cannot examine a checkout with no HANDOFF.md, and says 2, never 0
handoff-check exits 1 on it, which fails the gate
main with two sections waiting reads clean
removing a pending section without folding it is refused, since that drops it
rewriting an archived section is refused
the fold refuses to write over an archive that holds something else, and writes nothing
the handoff a fold could have written reads clean
the id after 0bv is 0bw, after 0bz 0ca, after 0z 0aa, and after 0zz 0aaa
the marker moves on to the id after the current one
the one that landed last is current, with the id after it
the rows go in newest first, above the newest numbered row and below the standing one
the section it replaced is archived exactly as it stood, its trailing blank line dropped
the section that landed first takes the next id and is archived, as it would have been had it been folded alone
